```{r,message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
```

# Load Cellranger count

```{r,message=FALSE}
# Load 10x dataset
o <- DropletUtils::read10xCounts("/mnt/Data/Bioinfo_platf/wyss_project/docker_envi/apps/geo_download/downloads/GSE224407/GSM7021828_E19_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
# o <- splitAltExps(o,rowData(o)$Type,ref = "Gene Expression")
rownames(o) <- make.unique(mcols(o)$Symbol)
```

# Demultiplex HTO tags

## Load HTO counts

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Add HTO information (filtering for missing cells)
o <- local({
  hto <- DropletUtils::read10xCounts("filtered_feature_bc_matrix_HTO.h5")
  o <- o[,o$Barcode %in% hto$Barcode] # Remove cell with none matching barcode in the HTO
  altExp(o,"Antibody Capture") <- hto[,match(o$Barcode,hto$Barcode)]
  o
})
```

## Perform HTO demultiplexing

```{r}
o$hto_call <- local({
  hto <- altExp(o,"Antibody Capture") |> 
    assay() |>
    as.matrix()
  hto <- hto[1:10,]
  hto <- t(hto/rowMeans(hto))
  
  plot(sort(hto),log="y")
  heatmap(log1p(hto[sample(nrow(hto),1000),]),scale="none")
  
  hto_call <- colnames(hto)[max.col(hto)]
  hto_call[-rowQ(-hto,1) < 1] <- "unclear"
  hto_call[-rowQ(-hto,1) - -rowQ(-hto,2) < 0.3] <- "unclear"
  hto_call
})

ggcells(o) + 
  geom_bar(aes(y=hto_call))
```

# Add gene annotations

```{r,message=FALSE}
# Add genes annotations
rowData(o) <- cbind(
  rowData(o),
  local({
    meta <- read.table("../01_genome/mouse/data/gene_info.tsv",sep="\t",header=TRUE)
    meta[match(rowData(o)$ID,meta$ensembl_gene_id),]
  })
)
```

# QC 

## Compute QC metrics

```{r}
o <- scuttle::addPerCellQCMetrics(o,subsets=list(mt=grep("^mt-",rownames(o)),Rp=grep("^Rp",rownames(o))))
o$qc <- "pass"
o$qc[o$hto_call %in% "unclear"] <- "fail_hto"
```

### Transcriptomics

```{r}
o$qc[o$subsets_Rp_percent >= 15] <- "rna_high_Rp"
o$qc[o$subsets_mt_percent >= 15] <- "rna_high_mt"
o$qc[o$sum < 1000] <- "rna_low_count"
o$qc[o$detected < 1000] <- "rna_low_detected"
```

### ATAC
```{r}
o$qc[o$altexps_Peaks_sum < 3000] <- "atac_low_count"
o$qc[o$altexps_Peaks_detected < 1000] <- "atac_low_detected"
```


## QC summary
```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_bar(aes(fill=qc,y=cond),color="black") + 
  ylab("")
```



### Read count

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=sum,y=cond),scale="width") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=min(o$sum[o$qc %in% "pass"]),linetype=2) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  xlab("Read count") + ylab("")
```

### Detected genes

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=detected,y=cond),scale="width") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=min(o$detected[o$qc %in% "pass"]),linetype=2) + 
  xlab("Num. detected gene") + ylab("")
```

### Mitochondrial genes

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=subsets_mt_percent,y=cond),scale="width") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=max(o$subsets_mt_percent[o$qc %in% "pass"]),linetype=2) +
  xlab("% Mitochondrial") + ylab("")
```

### Ribosomal proteins

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=subsets_Rp_percent,y=cond),scale="width") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=max(o$subsets_Rp_percent[o$qc %in% "pass"]),linetype=2) +
  xlab("% Ribosomal protein") + ylab("")
```

### Read-count / Detected-gene

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=sum,y=detected,color=qc)) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  xlab("Read count") + ylab("Num. detected gene") + theme(legend.position = "none")

```

## ATAC-seq QC

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=altexps_Peaks_sum,y=cond),scale="width") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=min(o$altexps_Peaks_sum[o$qc %in% "pass"]),linetype=2) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  xlab("ATAC read count") + ylab("")
```

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_violin(aes(x=altexps_Peaks_detected,y=cond),scale="width") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept=min(o$altexps_Peaks_detected[o$qc %in% "pass"]),linetype=2) + 
  xlab("Num. ATAC peak") + ylab("")
```

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=sum,y=altexps_Peaks_sum,color=qc)) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  scale_y_log10() + 
  coord_equal() + 
  xlab("Transcriptomics read-count") + ylab("ATAC read-count")

ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=detected,y=altexps_Peaks_detected,color=qc)) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  scale_y_log10() + 
  coord_equal() + 
  xlab("Num. detected gene") + ylab("Num. ATAC peak")
```

# Dimensionality reduction

## PCA

```{r}
o <- runPCA(o,BSPARAM=IrlbaParam(),BPPARAM=MulticoreParam())
```

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=PCA.1,y=PCA.2,color=log10(detected))) + 
  coord_equal()

ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=PCA.1,y=PCA.2,color=cond)) + 
  coord_equal()
```

## UMAP

```{r}
set.seed(123456)
o <- runUMAP(o,dimred="PCA",BPPARAM=BiocParallel::MulticoreParam())
```

```{r}
ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=UMAP.1,y=UMAP.2,color=log10(detected))) + 
  coord_equal()

ggcells(o) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=UMAP.1,y=UMAP.2,color=cond)) + 
  coord_equal()
```
